name: Enter the birthday experience and navigate its sections
description: Verifies the simplified invitation and cupid artwork lead into the birthday letter and the main navigation reaches the confession and gallery.
expected: The uncluttered For Riri invitation and cupid illustration display, then the birthday letter, confession, and gallery render from the section navigation.

name: Expand the birthday letter
description: Verifies the birthday note can be expanded to reveal its closing wishes and signature on a phone-sized viewport.
expected: The additional birthday wishes and Shay Shay signature become visible.

name: Read the personal confession and three-year callback
description: Verifies the dedicated confession page communicates sincere romantic interest without a forced response.
steps: Read the confession to its closing line
expected: The page includes the sincere attraction message, appreciation of her ambition, and the three-year callback.

name: Open the photo gallery and view a photo
description: Verifies the gallery remains usable before personal media is uploaded and opens an image viewer.
expected: A photo tile opens a dismissible viewer, and missing media displays a friendly placeholder rather than a broken image.

name: Control the soundtrack
description: Verifies soundtrack playback is user initiated and can be paused or muted.
expected: The soundtrack controls respond without autoplaying audio before the visitor enters or presses play.
